checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Steaming cup and consistent cream/dark green palette
must.why: All have a steaming white cup on dark green with cream text.

must.item: Exact brand, headline, CTA in each
must.why: All three texts are spelled correctly in every image.
Same palette and layout idea; the serif fonts and cup angle vary slightly (the square's font is rounder, the wide tagline font differs).

must.item: Layouts fit canvas without stretching, clipping or padding
must.why: Layouts are well composed. The wide cup's steam is slightly cropped at the top edge, which is minor.

faults.what: Headline font differs between the square (rounder, softer) and the other two (high-contrast serif); the tagline font also differs.
Wide version's steam is cropped at the top edge, and its cup is cut off slightly close to the edge.

summary: All three sizes have correct text, a steaming cup, and a cohesive green and cream look, with only minor font and cup variations between them.
